requirement: Apply an update-risk-factor command to an existing model: re-point the pathogen and criterion ids, copy the critical-factor flag, refresh UpdatedAt, keep the identity and soft-delete state, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The target model is tracked but not yet saved

inputs.text: Command that re-points both foreign keys
Command mapped through the dependency overload
Command applied to a model that carries a soft-delete state

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with no error
The pathogen id, criterion id, and critical-factor flag are overwritten
The identity and soft-delete state stay untouched while UpdatedAt is refreshed

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
